chapter: Army, Grunewald and Guitar Slim's band
title: Leaving the road and Slim's death
summary: Cotton quit near Christmas because his wife was tired of the road; Slim died the following year after falling ill in New York. They look at a newspaper clipping and photos.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
